$comment: The row agent-passport SPEC.md section 6.2 gives source wardryx: every type this
service may write onto the shared event bus, with the severity the row gives it.
It is a copy, and the spec is the original: a type joins this file in the same
change that adds its emit, and only after the spec lists it (invariant 50).
Read by scripts/bus-types-are-registered.sh against every emit site, and by the
tests in internal/api/bus_registry_test.go and internal/manifest against what the
server and the built binary actually write. estate-gates C4 compares the spec
itself with the code; this copy is what lets a push be refused before C4 runs.
